news.headline: Wall Street rout: Nasdaq -5.5%, S&P 500 -4.4%, Dow -3.4% in AI/chip meltdown
news.what_happened: Nvidia and Qualcomm fell 9%+ on fears that AI data-center buildout slows after US midterm results and a weak Qualcomm outlook. Nasdaq entered correction, worst day since April 2025; ~$3T wiped out.
news.why_it_matters: Strong risk-off global signal: FII selling risk for India, Indian IT valuations under pressure, defensives relatively better.

news.headline: Asia tumbles: Nikkei -5.7%, Kospi -7%, Hang Seng -0.9%
news.what_happened: Asian chip-heavy markets sold off hard after the US drop. Nikkei closed near 57,600 (-5.7%).
news.why_it_matters: Broad Asia risk-off; Nifty, after a +2.4% run yesterday (close 24,537), is likely to open lower and may give back gains.

news.headline: Crude volatile: WTI ~$91.5 (+1.1%) after ~12% fall earlier this week
news.what_happened: Brent ~$99.8 (+1.6%), bouncing from $94.6 low on Nov 4, but far below $117 on Oct 30.
news.why_it_matters: Lower crude vs last week remains a macro tailwind for India (CAD, inflation); today's small uptick is minor next to the global equity selloff.

news.headline: Indian markets rallied into the US crash: Nifty +2.4% to 24,537, Sensex +3.1%
news.what_happened: Nifty closed Nov 5 at 24,536.6, extending a multi-day rally (22,699 on Oct 28). Rupee firmer at ~94.46; US 10Y eased to 4.84%.
news.why_it_matters: Elevated base into a global shock raises gap-down and profit-booking risk today.

sector_outlook.reason: Nasdaq -5.5%, tech valuation de-rating; rupee flat
FII selling risk after global rout
Crude +1% today but down sharply on the week

picks.logic: Low-beta FMCG leader with minimal FII-tech exposure; in sharp risk-off sessions money rotates to defensives. Crude well below last week's levels also eases packaging and palm-derivative input costs.

picks.catalyst: Global risk-off; defensive pharma, USD earner
picks.logic: Pharma is a classic defensive in risk-off tape; rupee stable-to-firm so no FX headwind from a sharp reversal, and stock has been flat while Nifty rallied, so less to give back.

risks: GIFT Nifty and FII flow data not available at generation time; check the gap at open before entry
Nifty rallied 2.4% yesterday; gap-down could be sharp and defensives may fall too in a broad liquidation
Further US/Asia volatility (Nikkei -5.7%, Kospi -7%) can override sector logic; keep size small
eod_summary: Both defensive picks hit target: HINDUNILVR +1.7%, SUNPHARMA +2.03% (open-to-close). Nifty closed 25,030 (+2.0% vs prior close 24,537) despite the global rout.
